name: Roborock Q7 M5
summary: A budget robot vacuum and mop whose charge-only dock is just 6.3 × 2.8 in, small enough to slide under a sofa. Four independent reviews agree it has strong suction and reliable LiDAR mapping for the price, but two hit the same app bugs, and it has no front obstacle sensor.
idealFor: The smallest apartments, where even a dock tower is too much
Buyers under $300 who can empty a bin by hand
pros: Tiny charge-only dock (6.3 × 2.8 in) that fits under a sofa
Strong suction for the price in Vacuum Wars bench tests
Accurate LiDAR mapping; chunky wheels clear tall thresholds
cons: Not self-emptying (the Q7 M5+ adds an auto-empty dock)
No front obstacle sensor: clear cables and socks first
TechRadar and T3 both hit app bugs: lost room names, zones that didn't save
Long hair wraps the roller, and the mop leaves floors wet

trust.summary: Four independent hands-on reviews agree it vacuums well for the price, but TechRadar and T3 both report app bugs (room names lost, zones not saved), so it loses the recurring-failure check. Roborock publishes dimensions, an IEC-tested suction claim, a 1-year warranty and spare parts support. Safety scores 8/20: no CPSC recalls, but we could not verify a UL/ETL listing or FCC ID for this model.

sources.title: TechRadar: Roborock Q7 M5 robot vacuum review
sources.note: Ruth Hamilton, July 2025, a week as the main vacuum. Reliable mapping, patchy obstacle avoidance; app forgot room names and failed to save a routine

sources.title: T3: Roborock Q7 M5 review
sources.note: Lee Bell, July 2025, several weeks. Good on crumbs and pet hair; setup took about five attempts; room names disappeared and zones wouldn't save

sources.title: Tom's Guide: Roborock Q7 M5 review
sources.note: Amy Cutmore, Oct 2025, three weeks at home. 93.3% on tile, 85% on carpet; 53–72 dB by phone meter at 1 m; stuck under a low TV cabinet; hair wraps the roller

sources.title: Vacuum Wars: Roborock Q7 M5 and M5+ review
sources.note: Bought by Vacuum Wars. Suction 2.24 kPa vs 0.83 average, 75% embedded sand, 79% pet hair, 43% hair wrap; no front obstacle avoidance
